aboutIntro: From office workflows to warehouses and dashboards, my work is connected by one habit: make the data agree before anyone makes a decision with it.
aboutBody: I’m a data engineer with more than nine years across information systems, data warehousing and business intelligence, mostly in pharmaceutical distribution and construction in Istanbul.

I build ETL pipelines in SQL Server and Python, model data into star schemas, and deliver Power BI dashboards that management uses to track KPIs. I care about the unglamorous parts too: access control, backups, data quality and queries that stay fast.

I studied Computer Systems Engineering at Cordoba Private University. My first roles were in information coordination, and moving from filing systems to databases taught me that most data problems start as process problems.

Alongside my full-time work I run RD Group, a small digital-solutions business building websites, SEO and branding for international clients. My next step is going deeper into data engineering and AI, with a European master’s degree as the milestone.
focus: Medallion pipelines (Raw, Silver, Gold), dimensional modelling, and moving from Power BI reporting toward Microsoft Fabric data engineering.

points: Led the move from legacy office administration workflows to digital information systems, improving data entry efficiency and accuracy across departments.
Designed and maintain end-to-end ETL pipelines in SQL Server and Python that aggregate operational and financial data from several business units.
Implemented a Medallion data-cleaning framework (Raw, Silver, Gold) to validate schemas, remove redundancy and protect data quality.
Built Power BI dashboards with advanced DAX that give the executive team live KPI and operational insight.
Manage database access control and data governance, with optimised SQL for secure, low-latency internal reporting.
Run a small digital-solutions business delivering WordPress web design and development, SEO and branding for international clients.
Coordinated cross-functional IT and administrative projects, aligning business requirements with information-system deliverables.
Modelled star schemas with fact and dimension tables to centralise supply chain, procurement and CRM data.
Produced weekly and monthly performance reports in advanced Excel (PivotTables, Power Query) to surface operational bottlenecks.

Standardised presentation materials, invoices and performance tracking.
